harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: His saying «والزيتون»: conjoined to «التين»; the wāw is not that of the oath, otherwise each of the two nouns would need an answer.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «سينين»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with fatḥa because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and foreign.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (لقد خلقنا الإنسان في أحسن تقويم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam); the preposition «في أحسن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الإنسان».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «أسفل»: an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb); it was originally an adjective of an omitted place, i.e.: a lower place; and the clause «رددناه» is conjoined to the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «فلهم أجر» is conjoined to the clause «وعملوا»; «غير»: naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «فما يكذبك» is resumptive; «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «بعد»: an adverb of time cut off from annexation, the original being: after the mention of man.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: (أليس الله بأحكم الحاكمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of ليس.
